item.title: Fitness: How soon can you resume physical activity after knee-replacement surgery?
item.description: The better shape you're in when you go into the surgery, the more likely you are to have a speedy return to play.

item.title: Montreal weather: Colder, flurries and a deep freeze overnight
item.description: Clear skies overnight with a low of minus 19 and a wind chill of minus 26.

item.title: A total lunar eclipse will be visible from Montreal on Tuesday
item.description: Those who want to wake up early to witness the phenomenon should get to high ground with an unobstructed view of the western horizon, astrophysicist says.

item.title: Trudeau airport sees flight disruptions after U.S. and Israel strike Iran
item.description: Air Canada announced Saturday that flights to and from the Middle East are suspended.

item.title: Montreal police treating 18-year-old man's death as suspicious
item.description: A 911 call was made early Sunday regarding a person injured inside an apartment on St-André St. near Ontario St. in the Ville-Marie borough.

item.title: Boil-water advisory in effect for area spanning West Island municipalities and St-Laurent
item.description: Around 200 addresses are affected in an area covering parts of Dollard-des-Ormeaux, Dorval and Pointe-Claire, as well as a small part of the St-Laurent borough.

item.title: McGill will establish an AI education and research centre in India
item.description: The announcement was made during an academic mission to India led by Universities Canada, in the presence of Prime Minister Mark Carney.

item.title: Pedestrian who collapsed in middle of road and was struck by SUV has died
item.description: The 71-year-old man was injured Saturday evening in Ahuntsic-Cartierville.

item.title: Montreal Victoire shuts out Minnesota Frost, takes No. 1 ranking in PWHL
item.description: It was captain Marie-Philip Poulin's first game since the Olympic break, after sitting out Thursday's match against New York to recover from an injury.

item.title: Félix Auger-Aliassime got safely out of Dubai just before airspace was shut
item.description: The 25-year-old Montreal tennis star left Saturday on one of the last flights out of the city, his agent said.
